lin_poacher.text: Plum bread with a slice of Lincolnshire Poacher cheese. Sweet and sharp. That's the county on a plate.
There's no plums in plum bread. 'Plum' used to mean any dried fruit. Same with plum pudding. Victorians, eh.

lin_baker.text: Sit down, get your breath back. Everybody arrives in here panting. It's the hill.
